Class ChaosEffectAppliedEvent

java.lang.Object
jdk.jfr.Event
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.bootstrap.jfr.ChaosEffectAppliedEvent
@Internal public final class ChaosEffectAppliedEvent extends Event
JFR event emitted each time a chaos effect is applied to a matched JVM operation.

Disabled by default — this event fires on every intercepted operation and can reach high frequency under load. Enable on demand via a JFR profile or -XX:StartFlightRecording with an appropriate threshold, or via JMC's event settings panel during a recording session.

Fields operationType and effectType allow selective filtering in JFR queries: 

SELECT scenarioId, operationType, effectType, sessionId
FROM com.macstab.chaos.jvm.EffectApplied
WHERE effectType = 'DelayEffect'
